metadata.measurements: Desktop Chromium, fresh browser per run, clocks begin at local data creation or trusted button handler. Mount/seek/update clocks end at visible Element Timing status marker. Complete visits also verify a visible tile by hit test.
metadata.model: One object per record (id, group, score). Full mode connects a cell element per record in 4096-cell bands; native React, Solid and Svelte use a framework root per band. Every cell has one text child. The fixed-input control keeps a class instance per cell. The two band variants retain either a dense array of text nodes or retrieve changed nodes from the host. All Saba arms use setAttribute. No garbage collection is forced. Every implementation receives the same immutable per-band record snapshots. Virtual mode mounts 8 columns, 16 visible rows and up to two overscan rows per side.
metadata.checkpoints: DOM count and last-cell layout confirmed for full chunks. Marker presentation sampled every >=32768 cells and at successful completion. Peak is sampled RSS of the isolated browser’s renderer processes, including baseline.
